title: My Dog Came Home… Wrong 😨 (Part 3)
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story from Creepyville. Bruno is back. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: Since my dog came home wrong, I lock my bedroom door every night.
Tonight, the lock on my door started beeping.
That's my birthday. Only family knows it.
He walked in slowly. On four legs this time.
He sat by my bed, wagging his tail. Like a good boy.
Then I heard Mum's car outside.
Through the window, I saw her get out, holding the leash.
Our dog was with her. Bruno.
I looked back at my bed.
*The thing beside me stopped wagging. And smiled.
Would you hide under the bed, or run to Mum? Comment A or B.
